name: @pipeworx/mcp-tvmaze

tools.name: search_shows
tools.description: Search TV shows by name. Returns shows with id, name, premiere date, network, genres, rating, status, and TVMaze URL.

tools.name: get_show
tools.description: Fetch a full show record by TVMaze ID. Optionally embed episodes, cast, seasons, or previous/next episode info for richer responses.

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List all episodes of a show. Returns season, number, name, airdate, runtime, and summary.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: What TV shows are airing on a given day in a country. Useful for "what aired last night on UK TV". Returns episode + show records.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search TVMaze's actor/person database by name. Returns matched people with id, name, country code, birthday, deathday, gender, and headshot image URL.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tvmaze forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tvmaze pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
